text_block_list.text:
"T-Thank you for reading"...?
Why?! It was getting so good, and we were finally learning about the characters' backstories...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I sent in the reader survey questionnaire...!
Wait, no way, that's a lie... I can't believe this...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No waaaay, I can't read what happens next...?!"
